options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: force_delete
options.description: Set to true to delete the cluster even when Secondary nodes exist, orphaning them. Use this only when Secondary nodes are unreachable/decommissioned.

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this call is intended. When unspecified, the current node (the primary) is used. Set the node name to `cluster` to target the entire cluster. This parameter can only be used when clustering is initialized.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
